description: This file defines a React functional component named Navbar, which renders the navigation bar for the admin panel of the application. It handles user navigation links, displays the current user role, and includes a logout functionality that interacts with a data service.

methods.name: Navbar({ user })
methods.description: React functional component that renders the navigation bar with user-specific links and logout functionality.

methods.name: onLogout
methods.description: Asynchronous function that logs out the user via dataService and navigates to the login page.
